title: Turtle Beach's new "Command Series" gaming mice will go on sale on October 30! The lineup includes three models, including a mouse with a touchscreen display. - Saiga NAK

 New Turtle Beach Command Series Gaming Mice Release October 30! Lineup of 3 Models Including a Touch-Display Mouse
 Product 
 2026.10.28(Wed) 
 SB C&S Corp. announced that it will release three Command Series gaming mice from VOYETRA TURTLE BEACH, INC.'s gaming brand, Turtle Beach , on Friday, October 30, 2026.
Sales will roll out sequentially via the official Turtle Beach store, Amazon.co.jp, and electronics retailers nationwide in Japan (excluding select stores).
 Note: This article is based on information released in Japan. For pricing and availability in each country or region, please refer to the respective local official websites.
 3 Command Series Gaming Mice Arrive from the Gaming Brand Turtle Beach! Includes a Model Equipped with a Touch Display
 Command Series PR TIMES 
 Three Command Series gaming mice from the gaming brand Turtle Beach will launch on Friday, October 30, 2026:
 Command Series MC3
 Command Series MC5
 Command Series MC7
 The Command Series is a line of gaming mice featuring high-precision handling and versatile customization features.
Beyond gaming, the mice support a wide range of uses, from streaming to everyday tasks.
 The lineup features three models: the wired Command Series MC3, the wireless Command Series MC5 supporting a polling rate of up to 8,000Hz, and the high-end Command Series MC7 equipped with a 2.25-inch color touch display !
 Command Series New Product Lineup
 Command Series MC3
 Command Series MC3 PR TIMES 
 The Command Series MC3 is a wired gaming mouse supporting up to 30,000 DPI.
It also features the Owl-Eye optical sensor for high-precision movement tracking and a 1,000Hz polling rate.
 In addition to vertical scrolling, the mouse is equipped with a 4D scroll wheel that supports left-and-right tilt inputs, as well as a clickable side-scroll barrel.
Users can assign up to 29 functions using the Easy-Shift feature, while the wired connection with a lightweight, flexible cable delivers lag-free, high-precision control:
 MSRP: 11,800 yen (tax included)
 Command Series MC5
 Command Series MC5 PR TIMES 
 The Command Series MC5 is a wireless gaming mouse supporting a polling rate of up to 8,000Hz.
It supports three connection modes: 2.4GHz wireless, Bluetooth, and wired .
Equipped with a 4D scroll wheel, the mouse lets users assign up to 29 functions.
It also offers up to approximately 90 hours of battery life and can be used while charging by connecting a USB-C cable:
 MSRP: 17,800 yen (tax included)
 Command Series MC7
 Command Series MC7 PR TIMES 
 The Command Series MC7 is a high-end wireless gaming mouse equipped with a 2.25-inch color touch display !
Users can adjust DPI, switch profiles, execute macros, and control apps directly from the display.
 In addition to supporting a polling rate of up to 8,000Hz, it features an adaptive 4D scroll wheel that lets users switch scrolling modes depending on the task.
Two swappable batteries and a dedicated charging dock are included to support extended sessions:
 MSRP: 23,800 yen (tax included)
 For more details on each product, please check the official Turtle Beach website product page .
The mice can be purchased through online stores such as Yahoo! Shopping , Amazon.co.jp , and Rakuten Ichiba , as well as electronics retailers nationwide in Japan (excluding select stores)!
 Note: This article is based on information released in Japan. For pricing and availability in each country or region, please refer to the respective local official websites.
